base_dir.description: Base directory for runtime files (logs, cache, etc.)

log_level.description: Verbosity level for logs (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL)

worker_threads.description: Number of worker threads for data processing and uploads

max_concurrent_requests.description: Maximum number of simultaneous HTTP requests to external services

enable_telemetry.description: Send anonymized metadata (station ID, time, frequency range) to central e-Callisto server

central_host.description: Hostname or IP of the central e-Callisto server

central_port.description: Port of the central e-Callisto server

calibration_cache_dir.description: Directory to store cached calibration data from the central server

enable_calibration_cache.description: Use local cache for calibration data to reduce network requests

max_calibration_cache_size.description: Maximum size (MB) of the calibration cache before old entries are purged

hw_config_path.description: Path to hardware configuration file (station ID, receiver type, gain, etc.)

data_store_dir.description: Directory for storing raw observation data (FITS files)

retention_days.description: Number of days to retain raw observation data before automatic deletion

compress_archived_data.description: Compress archived FITS files with gzip to save disk space

api_bind_interface.description: Network interface to bind the local API (empty = bind to all interfaces)

api_port.description: Port for the local HTTP API (used by monitoring tools and dashboards)

api_require_auth.description: Require basic auth (username/password) for API access

trusted_internal_ips.description: List of internal IPs that bypass API authentication (comma-separated)

cross_reference_stations.description: List of other e-Callisto stations to cross-reference for multi-station studies

url.description: Base URL of the station's data endpoint

tls_enabled.description: Enable TLS for secure communication with central server and API

tls_key_path.description: Path to station's TLS private key

tls_ca_cert_path.description: Path to CA certificate for verifying central server

health_endpoint.description: HTTP path for health-check endpoints (e.g., Kubernetes liveness probe)

hw_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) to wait for hardware response before timeout

hw_retry_limit.description: Number of retries for failed hardware communication

hw_retry_delay.description: Seconds to wait between hardware retries

sampling_rate.description: Desired sampling rate (samples/sec); 0 = use hardware default

enable_spectrum_averaging.description: Enable real-time averaging of spectra to reduce noise

spectrum_averaging_count.description: Number of spectra to average per output record

min_upload_interval.description: Minimum time (seconds) between uploads to central server
